task_name: Fulfill Advisor Metal Offer, Produce & Speed Up Nails, and Upgrade Two Residential Buildings

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When an advisor coin offer for surplus Metal appears, and residential upgrades (including a skyscraper upgrade) require Nails and Metal.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Selling surplus Metal (19 in storage) earns easy Simoleons, and speeding up 1 Nail with 2 SimCash allows immediate completion of a residential zone and a high-rise skyscraper upgrade (+439 population).
preconditions: 2 SimCash available to finish Nails instantly
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Queue 3 Nails in the Building Supplies Store, speed up the first Nail, and upgrade the right residential zone and the left high-rise apartment.

steps.who: Simoleon offer bubble near the northern factories
steps.briefing: click 'I'll Do It!' to sell 4 Metal for 41 Simoleons.

steps.who: floating Metal on the northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect finished Metal and re-queue Metal.
drag Nails into all three production slots and click the 2 SimCash speed-up button to finish the first Nails immediately, then collect it.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the rightmost Residential Zone
steps.briefing: drag Metal (19/2) and Nails (2/2) onto the zone to upgrade it.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the tall left apartment building
steps.briefing: drag Metal (19/3) onto the building to upgrade it into a skyscraper.
